span.p:
Global Traffic Manager (Route53)
Latency-based routing to nearest region

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 450px; text-align: center; width: 450px;

span.p:
User capacity: 500,000 to 1,000,000 (across both regions)
P99 latency (US user): 50ms
P99 latency (EU user): 100ms (includes replication lag)
Cost: ~$4,000/month per region
